yasyf-home blocker #2: `reposync install` (manifest-regen step) fails on **reposync's own state.json envelope mismatch** — `envelope: keys do not exactly match [schema host_registry repo_sync]`; on-disk state is flat-v0 with 40+ tracked repos (mtime Jul 24). Identical pattern to the box's synckit `[schema host_registry synckit]` error. That makes THREE interrupted swarm-era v0→v1 schema migrations now: cc-pool account store (home), reposync state (home), synckit state (box).

Disposition: home restart of serve/reconcile HELD (option 3) — restarting synckitd 0.36.2 into manifests still carrying `watch.backend` would reproduce the box's crash loop with zero gain; the 30-min observation window starts only from a reachable state. All four home binaries are current (synckitd 0.36.2, cc-pool 0.64.8, cc-notes 0.47.10, reposync 0.27.4); nothing destructive attempted; state files untouched (mtimes verified unchanged). Two source-diagnosis lanes now running (cc-pool store fingerprint; reposync state envelope — incl. whether `reposync host add` is the analogous migration to the recipe's `synckitd host add`, and whether the 40 tracked repos are re-derivable from disk). Open sub-question for the synckit side: cookiesync.json also carries stale `serve_args` and no regen path is accounted for — home lane sweeping synckitd --help (read-only) for helper-manifest regeneration.
